verdict.first_step_1: Inspect the starter's appearance and smell for signs of viability or spoilage before feeding and tracking rise in a marked jar.
verdict.first_step_2: Split the starter into two marked jars to run an immediate side-by-side feeding test comparing the new flour against the old flour.
verdict.reason: Reply 1 correctly explains in plain words that timing does not prove causation and prioritizes checking culture health and observing rise across feeding cycles over an immediate side-by-side test.
